Privacy Policy

Privacy Policy

How your information is handled when you visit this website and use the contact form.

Contents

1. Scope2. Information we collect3. Cookies and local storage4. How we use information5. Health data6. Information security7. Third-party links8. Your rights9. Changes and contact

Last updated: 12 November 2026

1. Scope

This Privacy Policy applies to visitors to the Kerim Kahraman | Healthcare Consulting website and to anyone who uses its contact form. Detailed information on the processing of personal data submitted through the contact form is provided in the Data Protection Notice.

2. Information we collect

The website only receives information that you voluntarily provide through the contact form:

  • Full name, email address and (optionally) phone number
  • Company / organisation name and country (optional)
  • Service of interest and the content of your message

To keep the website secure and available, the hosting infrastructure may retain technical logs such as IP address, browser type and time of visit for a limited period.

3. Cookies and local storage

This website does not use advertising, analytics or tracking cookies and contains no third-party tracking tools. Your chosen language is stored only in your browser’s local storage so the site can be shown in the same language on your next visit; it is never sent to the server and can be deleted at any time via your browser settings.

Fonts are served from the website’s own server; no requests are made to third-party services for this purpose.

4. How we use information

The information you provide is used only to review your enquiry, contact you and hold preliminary discussions about a possible collaboration. It is never used for marketing, sold or rented.

5. Health data

As our services are corporate consulting, the contact form does not request any information about your health. Please do not share health data about yourself or others in the form. Should such information be submitted by mistake, it will be deleted without being processed.

6. Information security

The website is designed to be served over an encrypted connection (HTTPS). Form data is limited to the fields that are strictly necessary, and reasonable technical and organisational measures are taken against unauthorised access.

7. Third-party links

The website may contain links to third-party services such as WhatsApp and LinkedIn. When you use these links, the privacy policy of the respective service applies.

8. Your rights

You have the rights listed in Article 11 of Turkish Law No. 6698 regarding your personal data. If you are visiting from outside Türkiye, any rights you have under the data protection laws of your own country remain unaffected. How to submit a request is explained in the Data Protection Notice.

9. Changes and contact

This policy may be updated when necessary; the current version is always published on this page. For any questions, please use the channels on our Contact page.
